title: Ana Our Wood Kiln Build Weekends
source_quote: Ana, Our Wood Kiln Scheduled Work Days. Spring 2026 Ana Our Wood Kiln workdays will be scheduled soon! We're getting closer to completing the wood kiln, and I'm calling on potters, builders, and curious folks alike to come lend a hand!
evidence_sentence: The page calls for volunteers to help build and reconstruct Ana, a Bourry box wood kiln being rebuilt at Creek Road Pottery.
evidence_quote: Ana Our Wood Kiln Scheduled Work Days. Spring 2026 Ana Our Wood Kiln workdays will be scheduled soon! We're getting closer to completing the wood kiln
summary: Help reconstruct Ana, a Bourry box wood kiln at Creek Road Pottery. Workdays are ongoing; bring gloves, boots, and curiosity. No prior kiln-building experience needed.
how_to_join: Message the potter or just show up ready to work at 917 Creek Road, Laceyville, PA 18623.
bring: gloves, boots, a hat, and your curiosity
